caption: The drawing features two detailed renderings of the same patterned dress, both depicted from the front and placed on a plain, light background. The larger dress, positioned to the right, shows a full-length garment with a high neckline, layered and ruffled skirt, and long sleeves ending at the wrist. The bodice includes a shawl-like overlay secured at the waist with a wide belt or sash, and the entire dress is decorated with a linear, checkered, or lattice pattern in shades of gray and black, suggesting intricate fabric detail. The smaller version of the dress appears to the left, drawn in the same style but at a reduced scale, displaying the same garment features and textile patterning. Both objects are rendered using fine, precise lines in black or gray ink on an off-white or cream-colored paper.
title: Dress
